title: Rationalization of the normalized completed tensor-Hom adjunction
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, a separated quasi-compact D.k-scheme X, and a finite extension E of Q_l. Suppose the recorded rational internal Hom is permitted on every pair of constructible objects [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Given an ordinary integral tensor presentation and its completion datum [def-sf-rational-verdier-data], there is, for each K in the raw rational constructible category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], an adjunction tensorLeft(K) ⊣ homRight(K). On every integral pair (K,M), its counit is the rational localization of ordinary evaluation preceded by the inverse specified completion map. This is only existence of the adjunction with its normalized counit; it asserts neither closure, identification with a Verdier duality datum, nor a finite-scalar square.

source.place: Original lem-sf-rational-hom-identifications steps 6--7: restrict the given ordinary adjunction, then scalar-localize its linear Hom equivalence.

proof.text: For each integral K, form the completed tensor-left functor and the permitted internal-Hom-right functor. The inclusion of the constructible category is fully faithful. The given natural completion transformation is invertible at every constructible pair and identifies ordinary tensor-left with completed tensor-left. Restrict the ordinary tensor-Hom adjunction using this isomorphism and the identity comparison on internal Hom.

The ambient internal-Hom bilinear action restricts to the full constructible subcategory. Hence its right-variable functor is additive and linear for the integral coefficient ring. An adjoint of an additive linear functor is additive and linear, so the completed tensor-left functor has these properties too.

Write the restricted Hom equivalence as a linear equivalence using its unit formula. Base change this linear equivalence and its inverse to the coefficient localization. Naturality is verified on pure tensors: both sides are the integral naturality equation multiplied by the product of the scalar coefficients. Tensor induction handles zero and sums. This constructs an adjunction between the raw scalar extensions.

The bilinear specifications of the recorded rational tensor and internal Hom give additivity and localized-ring linearity in the unfixed input. Their object equations and their pure-map equations identify them, by scalar-transport uniqueness, with the raw extensions of the two integral functors.

The counit of the base-changed Hom equivalence is its inverse at the identity, so equals one tensor the integral counit. The fully faithful restriction formula identifies that integral counit with inverse completion followed by the ordinary counit. Functor equality transports this equation heterogeneously to the required recorded functors.

proof_origin.place: The source argument restricted to this step; full proof in the Lean docstring.

mathlib_searches.query: A linear adjunction descends to raw scalar localization, preserving its counit
mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.localization and localization_counit_app use categorical localization instances, which the raw tensor category does not supply. ModuleCat scalar adjunctions apply to a different category. The raw Hom-equivalence extension is proved directly.
mathlib_searches.verdict: use the linear tensor extension of Hom equivalences

mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction transport along natural isomorphisms is available; Mathlib Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful and its counit formula give the integral restriction. They do not identify the recorded rational functors or coefficient comparisons.
mathlib_searches.verdict: generic restriction and transport APIs only

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib Localization.Adjunction provides localization of an adjunction using universal-property instances. The project supplies transport of linear functors in PbcRationalTransport, but no adjunction for that raw scalar transport. No duplicate of rationalHom_adjunction was found.
mathlib_searches.verdict: no exact theorem; generic raw scalar adjunction proved in this delivery

theorem rationalHom_adjunction
    (permitted : ∀ K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
      constructibleRationalHomPairs l E X (op K, M))
    (ordinary : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
    (completion : RationalVerdier.Completion D l hl X E ordinary) :
    ∃ adj : ∀ K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
      @tensorLeft l _ E _ _ _ X (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) K ⊣
        homRight l E X permitted K,
    ∀ (K M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X),
    HEq ((adj ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K)).counit.app
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj M))
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).map
        (ObjectProperty.homMk
          (X := (@constructibleIntegralTensor l _ E _ _ _ X
            (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X)).obj
              (K, (constructibleIntegralHom l E X).obj
                (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E X
                  ⟨(op ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K),
                    (sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj M), permitted _ _⟩)))
          (Y := M)
          ((@asIso _ _ _ _ (completion.map.app
            (K.obj, ((integralDerivedInternalHom l E X).obj (op K.obj, M.obj))))
            (completion.invertible K
              ((constructibleIntegralHom l E X).obj
                (integralPairOfRationalHomPair l E X
                  ⟨(op ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K),
                    (sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj M), permitted _ _⟩)))).inv ≫
            (ordinary.adjunction K.obj).counit.app M.obj)))
